shots.narration_english: "That journalist Iyaan is digging up far too much. He has to be stopped." Iyaan felt as if the blood in his body had frozen.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޢާޞިމްއަށް އޭނާގެ ހަގީގަތް އެނގުނީ ހެއްޔެވެ؟ ނޫނެކެވެ. ޢާޞިމް އެ ދެއްކީ އިޔާން ނޫހުގައި ލިޔަމުންދާ ސަރުކާރުގެ ކޮރަޕްޝަނުގެ ވާހަކަތަކެވެ.
shots.narration_english: Did Asim know his true identity? No. Asim was talking about the stories of government corruption Iyaan had been writing in the newspaper.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޢާޞިމަކަށް އިޔާންއަކީ އަސްލު ކާކު ކަމެއް އަދިވެސް ނޭނގެއެވެ. ނަމަވެސް، ޢާޞިމް އިޔާން މަރައިލަން ވެސް ފަސްނުޖެހޭނެކަން އެ ވާހަކައިން ސާފުވިއެވެ. "މާދަމާ ރޭ..."
shots.narration_english: Asim still did not know who Iyaan really was. But it was clear from his words that Asim would not hesitate even to have Iyaan killed. "Tomorrow night..."

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިޔާން މަޑުމަޑުން ބުނެލިއެވެ. "މާދަމާ ރޭ ޢާޞިމް ސިޔާސީ ބޮޑު ޖަލްސާއަށް ދާ ވަގުތަކީ އަހަރެން އެ ގެއަށް ވަންނާނެ ވަގުތު."
shots.narration_english: Iyaan said slowly. "Tomorrow night, when Asim goes to the big political rally, is when I will go into that house."
